Covered pauseAction (web L127-145) + render (web L147-174): web <Button variant='ghost' size='sm' onClick=handleTogglePause className='min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]' aria-label={paused?Resume:Pause}>{paused?<Play/>:<Pause/>}</Button> -> native <Pressable accessibilityRole='button' accessibilityLabel={paused?t('widget.signalLog.resume','Resume'):t('widget.signalLog.pause','Pause')} hitSlop=8 onPress=handleTogglePause style=44x44 tap target> glyph {paused?▶️:⏸️}. <WidgetShell title=t('widget.signalLog.title','Signal Log') icon=ScrollText glyph (text-neon-cyan->colors.accent) loading=isLoading updatedAt=dataUpdatedAt isFetching isStale isError onRefresh=()=>refetch() actions={!isCompact?pauseAction:undefined}> then body {isCompact?<CompactView rate t/>:<View flex-1 min-h-0><WidgetEventFeed items=displayItems maxItems=20 compact=false emptyMessage=t('widget.signalLog.noSignals','No signal updates yet') emptyIcon=ScrollText glyph/></View>}. export default + displayName retained.

Native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell incl. the `actions` slot (the Sentry port omitted it): loading skeleton, error body, the 1500ms green pulse-on-update effect (prevUpdatedAt ref), inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph+relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less), and BOTH header branches — title branch renders icon+title left / freshness+actions right (web flex items-center gap-2); title-less branch renders an absolute freshness overlay + a right-aligned actions row (web absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 + flex justify-end px-4 pt-3 pb-1). Native WidgetEventFeed mirrors the web shared feed + TimelineItem rows: formatRelativeTime ('Just now'/'{n}m ago'/'{n}h ago'(<24h)/formatDateTime) + formatDateTime (toLocaleString month/day/hour/minute, nullish->em-dash); limit=maxItems??(compact?3:10); sorted=[...items].sort(timestamp desc).slice(0,limit) via useMemo; empty->EmptyState t('widget.noEvents','No events yet') default; each row = colour-tinted (bg `${color}15`) rounded icon box + vertical connector (hidden on last) + title(truncate)/optional subtitle/relative time.

Visual adaptations documented: the feed icon box is min 32x32 (vs the Sentry glyph's fixed 32x32) with 4px horizontal padding so the variable-width source <Badge> (MQTT/API/Manual/Cache) sits inside the colour-tinted square without DOM-style overflow, preserving the web 'tinted box containing a coloured source pill' intent while keeping connector alignment. Badge uses the dark-theme variant colours the web Tailwind classes resolve to (success bg-green-900 #14532d / text-green-200 #bbf7d0, neutral bg-gray-700 #374151 / text-gray-200 #e5e7eb); badge text-xs rendered at 11px to fit the compact dot. The web full-layout overflow-y-auto wrapper is kept as a flex-1 min-h-0 <View> (feedScroll) but, like the Sentry port, the list itself is a bounded static column because rows are already hard-capped by maxItems=20 via .slice() and native dashboard tiles scroll within the screen container (avoids nested-scroll).

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/h3/span/p -> View/AppText; flex/gap -> flexDirection+columnGap/rowGap+gap; h-3.5 w-3.5 lucide -> 13-14px glyphs; h-5 w-5 empty icon -> 20px glyph; min-h/min-w-[44px] -> minHeight/minWidth 44; text-3xl -> 30px; text-[10px]/text-xs/text-sm -> 10/12/14; text-[var(--text-primary|secondary|muted)] -> colors.textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted; text-neon-cyan -> colors.accent; text-gray-600 -> #4b5563; rounded-full -> borderRadius 999; pulse shadow rgba(34,197,94,0.15) preserved. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the native AppText + theme tokens, and the already-ported web-parity useVehicles/useTelemetry hooks (+ SignalObservation type). Styles alphabetised (keys + properties) per react-native/sort-styles. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
